questions.answer: The cross product is \((1,0,0)\). Dotting with \((1,0,0)\) gives \(1\).

questions.prompt: Find the volume of the parallelepiped with edges \((2,0,0),(0,3,0),(0,0,4)\).
questions.answer: The scalar triple product is \(2\cdot3\cdot4=24\), so the volume is \(24\).

questions.prompt: Compute \([\mathbf a,\mathbf b,\mathbf c]\) for \(\mathbf a=(1,2,3)\), \(\mathbf b=(0,1,0)\), \(\mathbf c=(2,0,1)\).
questions.answer: First \(\mathbf b\times\mathbf c=(1,0,-2)\). Dot with \(\mathbf a\): \(1+0-6=-5\).

questions.prompt: Find the volume determined by \((1,1,0),(1,0,1),(0,1,1)\).
questions.answer: The triple product is \((1,1,0)\cdot((-1,-1,1))=-2\). Volume is its absolute value, \(2\).

questions.prompt: Use a scalar triple product to test whether \((1,0,0),(0,1,0),(1,1,0)\) are coplanar.
questions.answer: All vectors lie in \(z=0\). Also \((0,1,0)\times(1,1,0)=(0,0,-1)\), dot with \((1,0,0)\) gives \(0\), so they are coplanar.
The cross product is \((-6,-1,2)\). Dotting gives \(2(-6)+1(-1)+0(2)=-13\).

questions.prompt: Find the oriented volume sign for \(\mathbf i,\mathbf j,\mathbf k\).
questions.answer: \(\mathbf j\times\mathbf k=\mathbf i\), and \(\mathbf i\cdot\mathbf i=1\). The orientation is positive.

questions.prompt: Find the volume of the tetrahedron with edge vectors \((1,0,0),(0,2,0),(0,0,3)\) from one vertex.
questions.answer: The parallelepiped volume is \(1\cdot2\cdot3=6\). A tetrahedron has one sixth of this volume, so its volume is \(1\).

questions.prompt: Compute the determinant form of the scalar triple product for rows \((1,2,0),(3,1,1),(0,2,4)\).
Show that swapping two vectors changes the sign for \((\mathbf i,\mathbf j,\mathbf k)\).
questions.answer: The product \(\mathbf i\cdot(\mathbf j\times\mathbf k)=1\). Swapping the first two gives \(\mathbf j\cdot(\mathbf i\times\mathbf k)=\mathbf j\cdot(-\mathbf j)=-1\).

questions.prompt: Find the volume spanned by \((2,0,1),(1,3,0),(0,1,4)\).
questions.answer: Compute \((1,3,0)\times(0,1,4)=(12,-4,1)\). Dot with \((2,0,1)\) gives \(25\), so the volume is \(25\).

questions.prompt: Test whether \((1,2,3),(2,4,6),(0,1,1)\) are linearly independent.
questions.answer: Because \((2,4,6)=2(1,2,3)\), the triple product is zero. The vectors are linearly dependent.

questions.prompt: Find the scalar triple product \(\mathbf a\cdot(\mathbf b\times\mathbf c)\) for \(\mathbf a=(0,2,1)\), \(\mathbf b=(1,-1,0)\), \(\mathbf c=(3,0,2)\).
questions.answer: \(\mathbf b\times\mathbf c=(-2,-2,3)\). Dot with \(\mathbf a\) gives \(0-4+3=-1\).

questions.prompt: Find the area-times-height interpretation for triple product value \(-18\).
questions.answer: The sign gives orientation. The volume is the absolute value, so the parallelepiped volume is \(18\).

questions.prompt: For \(\mathbf a=(1,1,1)\), \(\mathbf b=(1,0,2)\), \(\mathbf c=(0,1,t)\), find \(t\) for volume \(3\).
questions.answer: \(\mathbf b\times\mathbf c=(-2,t,-1)\). Dot with \(\mathbf a\) gives \(t-3\). Volume is \(|t-3|=3\), so \(t=0\) or \(t=6\).

questions.prompt: Find the oriented volume of the parallelepiped with edges \((1,2,3),(4,5,6),(7,8,9)\), and explain what the result says about the three edges.
questions.answer: Use the determinant \(\begin{vmatrix}1&2&3\\4&5&6\\7&8&9\end{vmatrix}\). Expanding gives \(1(45-48)-2(36-42)+3(32-35)=-3+12-9=0\). Equivalently, \((7,8,9)-2(4,5,6)+(1,2,3)=(0,0,0)\), so the third edge is linearly dependent on the first two. The oriented volume is \(0\), meaning the edges are coplanar.

questions.prompt: A box has edge vectors \((2,0,0),(1,3,0),(0,1,4)\). Find its volume.
questions.answer: Use \((2,0,0)\cdot((1,3,0)\times(0,1,4))\). The cross product is \((12,-4,1)\), so the triple product is \(24\).

questions.prompt: For \(\mathbf a=(a_1,a_2,a_3)\) and \(\mathbf b=(b_1,b_2,b_3)\), show by component calculation that \(\mathbf a\cdot(\mathbf b\times\mathbf a)=0\).
questions.answer: First \(\mathbf b\times\mathbf a=(b_2a_3-b_3a_2,b_3a_1-b_1a_3,b_1a_2-b_2a_1)\). Dot with \(\mathbf a\): \(a_1(b_2a_3-b_3a_2)+a_2(b_3a_1-b_1a_3)+a_3(b_1a_2-b_2a_1)\). Expanding gives \(a_1b_2a_3-a_1b_3a_2+a_2b_3a_1-a_2b_1a_3+a_3b_1a_2-a_3b_2a_1\). The terms cancel in pairs, so the result is \(0\).

questions.prompt: Find \(x\) if the parallelepiped volume from \((x,0,0),(0,2,0),(0,0,5)\) is \(30\).
questions.answer: The volume is \(|x\cdot2\cdot5|=10|x|\). Set \(10|x|=30\), so \(x=3\) or \(x=-3\).
